events.verdict: Highsmith (MIA) applies a hand to Suggs' (ORL) chest that affects his driving shot attempt.
Bitadze (ORL) briefly has an arm around Adebayo (MIA) as they engage and he immediately removes it.
Adebayo (MIA) brings his off-arm around da Silva (ORL) as he attempts to establish position and he quickly releases.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Herro's (MIA) pass is last touched by Highsmith (MIA) before going out of bounds.
Suggs (ORL) moves into Burks (MIA) to establish rebounding position but the contact is marginal.
Highsmith (MIA) establishes screening position in Queen's (ORL) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as the screen is set.
Queen (ORL) reaches in and initiates illegal contact to Herro's (MIA) arm before making contact with the ball.
Burks (MIA) illegally hooks his arm around Suggs (ORL) as he is losing his balance.
Burks (MIA) reaches for the loose ball and incidental arm contact occurs with Bitadze (ORL) prior to his put-back shot attempt.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
